sentences.en: The hunter aimed a shotgun at the flock of birds.
sentences.zh: 猎人用霰弹枪瞄准了一群鸟。

sentences.en: The hunter went deep into the forest, never to return.
sentences.zh: 猎人深入森林，从此再也没有回来。

sentences.en: The hunter unexpectedly found fresh blood droplets in the snow.
sentences.zh: 猎人在雪地里意外发现了新鲜的血滴。

senses.zh: 猎人,猎犬,猎狐马，猎食其他动物的野兽,亨特
